initialSvgRun.methodology: Built standalone client, actual authenticated Noise transport and Rust public egress; fresh native Chromium controls. Read/navigation/search/selection checks, no accounts, credentials, purchases or application forms. Proxy direct HTTP attempts blocked and counted, never used as fallback. Search and ordinary page scripts may send site telemetry. One sequential sample; timings include host load and test waits, not performance benchmarks.

configuration.styling: Loaded sheets plus computed body font matches the native control (known family fallback for proxy-only runs); screenshots supplement, not pixel equivalence

runs.methodology: Built standalone client, actual authenticated Noise transport and Rust public egress; fresh native Chromium controls. Read/navigation/search/selection checks, no accounts, credentials, purchases or application forms. Proxy direct HTTP attempts blocked and counted, never used as fallback. Search and ordinary page scripts may send site telemetry. One sequential sample; timings include host load and test waits, not performance benchmarks.

configuration.styling: Loaded sheets plus computed body font matches the native control (known family fallback for proxy-only runs); screenshots supplement, not pixel equivalence

runs.harnessRevisionNote: This revision clicked PixiJS Search once. The recheck allows a second click when the server-rendered button is present before hydration and the modal did not open.

runs.methodology: Built standalone client, actual authenticated Noise transport and Rust public egress; fresh native Chromium controls. Read/navigation/search/selection checks, no accounts, credentials, purchases or application forms. Proxy direct HTTP attempts blocked and counted, never used as fallback. Search and ordinary page scripts may send site telemetry. One sequential sample; timings include host load and test waits, not performance benchmarks.

configuration.styling: Loaded sheets plus computed body font matches the native control (known family fallback for proxy-only runs); screenshots supplement, not pixel equivalence
